findings: Accepted for the stylized spring vertical slice: connected low forks replace radial tiers; the mature spreading crown is furnished by small shoots, with sparser juvenile crowns.
Reviewed all 36 shaded variants: open, woodland and edge forms remain distinct without disconnected crowns. Botanical micro-detail remains limited by 100 mm voxels.
assessment: Initial pilot rejected; v2 replacement requires a new comparison.

art_baseline.foliage: Species-appropriate spring foliage and fresh growth; flowering only where appropriate to the species.
art_baseline.reference_policy: Use spring photographs for finished color and foliage. Other seasons may inform branch structure only.

previous_findings: Repeated radial tiers and thin major limbs do not match broad spreading beech scaffolds.
